pr_title: Bluetooth: Audio: Fix and move assigned numbers
pr_body:
Fix the definitions of the audio-related assigned numbers and remove them from lc3.h

Fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/43098

issue_context.title: Move the capabilities and configuration defines out of lc3.h
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
The Codec Capabilities and Configuration types defined in the Generic Audio assigned numbers are not LC3 codec specific. Move the common codec definitions out of lc3.h

review_comments:
looks like a breaking change or am I missing something? shouldn't the `...LC3...` option only be deprecated for now?
and would need entires in release notes / migration guide too

Ah, forgot that LE Audio was experimental, sorry. So yes, you're right, it's not strictly necessary. If you don't mind, and based on your comment re: how long they've been around, a short note in the migration guide would be welcome indeed. Thanks!
